name: Heaven And Hell
overview: Scripture clearly reveals the eternal destinies of humanity, emphasizing the reality of both heaven and hell. Jesus teaches that while the body may be killed, the soul can be destroyed in hell, a place of everlasting fire prepared for the devil and his angels, and reserved for the cursed (Matthew 10:28; 25:41). The righteous, by contrast, will inherit eternal life and enter paradise, as promised by Christ (Luke 23:43; Matthew 25:46). God's judgment is just and based on each person's deeds, with sin resulting in death but the gift of God being eternal life through Jesus Christ (Romans 2:6; 6:23).
